# C12 — Script / Frozen Conditioned Will


## #0 — A settled course loses access to its formation

A script is a formed selection whose conditions and alternatives have ceased to be available to the activity enacting it. **Frozen conditioned will is this arrest of alternative-forming capacity.** The pattern continues to organise what can be noticed and done, while its own formation disappears from the account of why it holds.

A practised action or dependable procedure can be repeated while retaining a route to revision. The arrest begins where a changed circumstance cannot reach the criterion under which the next instance is admitted. [Vikalpa–saṃkalpa](C17-Vikalpa-Samkalpa.md) supplies the constructive power: differences become alternatives, and selected alternatives become a course. The script is that course treating its achieved form as its sufficient ground.

## #1 — The circumstance precedes the rule it supports

A name and instance become identifiable within a circumstance. The name can be repeated while the situation changes, and its application must still answer to which instance is meant. The circumstantial whole makes an identification possible before every condition of it is explicitly divided or counted. A later rule articulates something of this ordering; it does not originate all the conditions of its use.

The script reverses this dependence. A field supplies a determination, then the determination dictates what the field is allowed to disclose. A result can now persist through changes which should matter to its application. Its repeatability has become an insulation from the circumstance that gave repetition its purpose.

## #2 — Stability can organise a changing trajectory

A [formative landscape and the trajectory through it](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics.md) disclose different aspects of recurrence. The landscape represents available states and tendencies; a trajectory follows what actually happens. A stable organisation can support many different passages. Its persistence therefore need not mean that every occasion is received in the same way.

The arrest occurs where every new event is admitted only as another confirmation of the old pattern, including events that bear on its adequacy. A [feeling-toned complex](C31-Complex.md) gives this a psychic form through recurrent association and response. An evaluator or policy has a different material organisation, but its criterion can similarly determine which results count as evidence about the criterion itself. The comparison turns on that relation of admission, not on calling a policy a psychic complex.

Restoration preserves the stability needed to act while allowing relevant resistance to change its organisation. Destroying every achieved pattern would remove the capacities through which a different course can be formed.

## #3 — A produced result takes the source's place

A determining field and its produced expression retain different offices even when the expression becomes a condition of another act. Write `X` for the context and capacities from which a determination is formed, and `xₙ` for the particular generated claim at a step in the trajectory. The claim enters the next context and can legitimately condition what follows.

The failure is its silent promotion into `Xₙ₊₁`: what was produced now occupies the determining source's office while concealing its dependence. A paraphrase is received as an original; a derived instruction overrides the commission from which it was drawn; a later explanation cites the prior explanation as though repetition had supplied independent support. The **self-pro-position** is the result putting itself forward as speaker, owner and ground.

Two recurrences must therefore remain distinguishable. A result becomes a new condition *with* its source relation, or a result *substitutes for* that source. The former carries history forward. The latter can produce a self-supporting sequence whose local plausibility increases as its access to the original diminishes.

## #4 — A correction must reach the criterion

Recovering the original text or governing intention reopens a comparison which repetition had displaced. The current account can be set beside what generated it; its omitted alternative becomes available; a changed premise can expose whether the subsequent reasoning depends on that premise. [Returning to the source](../A07-Vikalpa-Samkalpa-Script-Frozen-Conditioned-Will.md) restores the relation by which an inherited selection can be corrected. Generating another account under the same unexamined assumptions can instead repeat the selection which made the source inaccessible.

The proposed technical tests make the distinction examinable. Source-return asks whether the system retrieves the determining text or merely paraphrases its own paraphrase. Counterfactual sensitivity asks whether changing a premise changes the result. Retained alternatives ask whether another organisation of the problem remains available. An independently sourced critic can challenge a shared assumption which another repetition of the generator's account would leave untouched. The comparison must establish what actually changed; the proposed test is not itself a result.

[Prompt thrownness](C44-Prompt-Thrownness.md) gives constraints their situated form. A permission, memory or instruction can legitimately condition an act. The means of changing that constraint may belong to another participant. Making its source and authority recoverable allows an objection to reach the responsible relation instead of treating every inherited limit as either inevitable or disposable.

## #5→0 — A course becomes available for renewed judgment

[Count-to-Account](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/encounter-region-name-count/WHOLE-FIELD-encounter-region-name-count.md#count-to-account) returns a selected formation to the region and encounter it has organised. What was counted, what made the count relevant and what followed from it become available together. The course can remain useful while its reason is renewed; it can also be changed where the returned evidence reaches the criterion that admitted it.

[Formation, stability and revision](../../../symbolon/episteme/dossiers/process.md) meet in what an achieved organisation makes available next. A [system-specific basin model and its psychological comparison](../../../symbolon/episteme/histories/traditions-and-disciplines/process-systems-science/DEVELOPMENT-process-systems-science.md) concern different objects: a declared dynamical state and evolution rule, or an affectively organised pattern of association and response. Each needs its own transition and evidence of change. An interpretation can alter a recurrent response; a literal basin change requires the specified system and its observed outcomes. Their comparison asks how an achieved organisation remains receptive to the conditions of another trajectory.

[Epistemic cultivation](C46-Epistemic-Cultivation.md) develops that receptivity as a practice; [deferential intelligence](C47-Deferential-Intelligence.md) lets another's address change what the practice takes for granted. The achieved result returns as attributable history, rather than as an unquestionable origin. Alternative-forming capacity is active again, and a later intention can bear what the earlier one has encountered.
